exchangePage.title: Bitcoin ↔ euros in Portugal
exchangePage.lead: Parahub converts nothing and holds nothing — your keys stay in this browser. These are independent services; here is what each route really costs and how long it takes.

kraken.name: Kraken
kraken.what: Licensed exchange (MiCA, Central Bank of Ireland). Lightning in and out, euros over SEPA Instant.
sell: Open a Kraken account and verify your identity — once.
In Kraken: Deposit → Bitcoin → Lightning, and copy the invoice.
In Parahub: Send → paste that invoice → pay. The sats arrive in seconds.
Sell BTC/EUR in the trade view, then Withdraw → SEPA Instant (€1, near-instant).
buy: Open a Kraken account and verify your identity — once.
Send euros from your bank by SEPA Instant — free, minutes.
Buy BTC/EUR in the trade view.
In Parahub: Receive → Lightning, copy the invoice and paste it into Kraken's Lightning withdrawal.
kraken.note: Use the trade view, not the one-tap instant buy: that one costs 1% to 1.5%. At the lowest volume tier the trading fee is 0.40% maker / 0.80% taker. Withdraw large amounts on-chain — Lightning is built for small, instant transfers.

bringin.name: Bringin
bringin.what: Euro bridge built on Lightning, running on Lightspark Payments Europe (MiCA-licensed).
sell: Sign up at bringin.app and verify — once.
Add your IBAN and open a Lightning connection.
Pay it from Parahub over Lightning; the euros land on your bank account by SEPA Instant.
buy: Sign up at bringin.app and verify — once.
Transfer euros to the account Bringin gives you.
The sats come back over Lightning — paste a Parahub invoice or your Spark address.
bringin.note: Their bank bridge starts at around €30 per transfer, so it does not suit very small amounts.

p2p.name: RoboSats · Mostro
p2p.what: Person to person over a Lightning escrow. No account, no documents — the protocol holds the sats until both sides confirm.
sell: Open robosats.org (over Tor if you can) or any Mostro client — you get a random robot name, nothing to register.
Take a buy order in euros, or post your own with the payment method you want: SEPA Instant, Revolut, MB Way.
Lock the sats in the Lightning escrow from Parahub, wait for the euros to reach your bank, then confirm.
buy: Open robosats.org (over Tor if you can) or any Mostro client — you get a random robot name, nothing to register.
Take a sell order in euros, or post your own with the payment method you want.
Send the euros; the escrow releases the sats straight to a Parahub Lightning invoice.
p2p.note: The euro order book is thin and the premium the other side asks can run to several percent in either direction. Read the price before you commit — on a quiet day a licensed exchange comes out cheaper.

cash.name: Cash, face to face
cash.what: The oldest route: someone hands you notes, you send the sats from your phone.
sell: Agree a price — the mid-market rate from any price feed.
Take the cash and send the sats from Parahub over Lightning; both of you watch the screen.
To find counterparties beyond your own circle, Vexl matches you through your phone contacts — MiCA-licensed, holds nothing.
buy: Agree a price — the mid-market rate from any price feed.
Hand over the cash and receive the sats to a Parahub invoice; both of you watch the screen.
To find counterparties beyond your own circle, Vexl matches you through your phone contacts — MiCA-licensed, holds nothing.
cash.note: Cheapest and fastest for small amounts, and with no escrow it rests entirely on trusting the person in front of you. Association meetups are the natural place for it.

exchangePage.spendLead: Half the reason to convert disappears when the sats can be spent as they are.
spend: Bitrefill: top up MEO, NOS, Vodafone, UZO or Moche, and buy IKEA Portugal, Decathlon Portugal or multi-brand gift cards — paid over Lightning, delivered instantly.
Parahub market: pay members directly in sats, no conversion and no fee.
Membership fees, event tickets and energy settlements accept sats.
exchangePage.disclaimer: These are independent services. Parahub does not operate them, never holds your funds and takes no cut of these routes. Fees, limits and availability change — check on their side before you trade.
